_about: The Conductor's canned lines (settlement/Conductor.java). Each beat fires once per player: one short action-bar line (bar) and at most one chat line (chat). Edit freely, then /conductor reload. No AI key is used.
name: The Conductor

arrive.bar: Last stop. Welcome. The book is in your pack: open it.

book.bar: Good. Come and see me. Right-click me and I will show you the keys.

keys.bar: Two keys matter this hour: hold ` to mine a whole vein, and M for the map.

torch.bar: Light first. Torches behind you, always.

bed.bar: A bed. Good. Walls, a roof, a door. Then wait.

supply.bar: The Supply Camp. Put it down near here and the colony begins.

dusk.chat: Inside. Now. Don't answer the door.

dawn.chat: You made it. The city's that way. Take the stairs down only with a friend.

night.bar: The Line is on your map. Take a friend.
night.bar_none: The city is further than I can point. Follow the rails.

keys.chat: Keys: B backpack | M map | U waypoints | ` (hold) vein-mine, \ toggle it, O pattern | K shaders (off if Ponder goes black) | V voice menu | trash slot and sort button in your inventory.
keys.bar: Hold ` to vein-mine. M opens the map.

hints.torch: Place a torch. Light is the first rule.
hints.bed: Find a bed, walls and a door before dark.
hints.supply: The Supply Camp is in the chest by the fire. Take it.
hints.night: Get through the night. I will point the way after.
hints.done: The city is that way. Take a friend.
